title: Amazon Sum-vs-CAMA Fix + Trial Classification: Custom SumAggregation Bypassing pyg-lib Fused Path
summary: Demo notebook for the Amazon item-ltv experiment comparing sum vs mean vs CAMA aggregation in HeteroGraphSAGE. Demonstrates SafeSumAggregation (bypasses pyg-lib fused spmm path) and CAMAAggregation (cardinality-aware moment aggregation) with pure PyTorch unit tests verifying correctness, gradient flow, and gate initialization. Loads pre-computed results (10 runs across 3 methods), recomputes statistical analysis (Cohen's d, bootstrap CIs, t-tests), and visualizes MAE comparison, training curves, and effect sizes. CAMA achieves best MAE=46.97, outperforming sum (47.33) and mean (51.80).
